What are you going to do?
As a production worker, you will carry out different practical tasks in the production area. Together with your colleagues, you help make sure the work is done efficiently, safely and with good quality. The work is varied and hands-on. Your tasks include:

- Manual assembly work
- Preparing packaging materials for the machines
- Noticing simple machine problems and helping to solve them
- Putting labels on products
- Packing and repacking products, often based on customer requests
